rules.rule_context: Compliance note - click-to-cancel parity: the standard for recurring travel subscriptions and loyalty memberships sold direct-to-consumer is that the cancellation path matches the sign-up path in steps, time, and cognitive load. Cancellation paths that meet this standard do not add screens, mandatory offers, retention scripts, or confirmations beyond what the original purchase required. The rule covers any paid recurring product sold direct-to-consumer. It does not cover one-time bookings, corporate accounts, or partner-billed subscriptions.
